name: independent-youtube-playlist-manager
description: Generate YouTube playlists from bookmarks and URL lists
author: Mohammad El-Musleh <elmusleh.mohammad@gmail.com>

scripts.build: cd apps/browser-extension/playlist-manager && npm install && npm run build && cd ../../.. && node packages/build-tools/patch-innerhtml.js && npm run build-chrome && npm run build-firefox && node packages/build-tools/validate-manifests.js
scripts.build-chrome: [ -f apps/browser-extension/manifest.json ] && { echo 'ERROR: manifest.json template exists inside apps/browser-extension/'; exit 1; } || true; mkdir -p dist/chrome && rm -rf dist/chrome/* && cp -r apps/browser-extension/* dist/chrome/ && rm -rf dist/chrome/playlist-manager && cp apps/browser-extension/manifest.chrome.json dist/chrome/manifest.json
scripts.build-firefox: [ -f apps/browser-extension/manifest.json ] && { echo 'ERROR: manifest.json template exists inside apps/browser-extension/'; exit 1; } || true; mkdir -p dist/firefox && rm -rf dist/firefox/* && cp -r apps/browser-extension/* dist/firefox/ && rm -rf dist/firefox/playlist-manager && cp apps/browser-extension/manifest.firefox.json dist/firefox/manifest.json
scripts.sign-firefox: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && npx web-ext sign --source-dir=dist/firefox --artifacts-dir=dist/firefox/web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted'
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run pack:chrome && npm run pack:firefox
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && cd apps/browser-extension/playlist-manager && npx svelte-check
